question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Children below the age of 14 were not allowed to partisipate in the cooking competition.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"partisipate"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**participate**".
 
• **​"Participate" **means to take part in an activity or event. (भाग लेना)
 
 
• **Example: **Children are excited to **participate **in the event.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Competition **(प्रतियोगिता): A situation in which people or organizations compete with each other.

 
 
• **Example:** The **competition **was fierce, but she managed to win.
 
 
 
• **Children **(बच्चे): Young human beings below the age of puberty.
 
 
• **Example: Children **need proper guidance and education.
 
 
 
• **Allowed** (अनुमति दी): Given permission to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** You are **allowed **to go outside after finishing your homework.
